Rasmi replaces your default Phone dialer and your default SMS/MMS messaging app. To provide calling, SMS/MMS, spam protection, and related features, it needs the permissions explained below. Optional items (camera, microphone, location) are used only when you choose those actions (for example attaching a photo or sharing your location). Data stays on your device unless you explicitly use a network feature such as MMS or loading a web link preview.
Rasmi reads your phone numbers and SIM information to make calls, send messages, and identify which line is being used. This information stays on your device.
Rasmi reads and writes your contacts to display names and photos in calls and messages, and to let you save new contacts. Contacts are not transmitted off the device.
As your default messaging app, Rasmi reads, sends, and receives SMS and MMS messages. Message content is processed locally to detect OTP codes and spam.
Rasmi reads and writes your call log to show your call history, return missed calls, and identify blocked numbers.

If you tap share location in a conversation or during a call, Rasmi accesses device location only to attach or send that location. It is not used for advertising and is not collected in the background for tracking.
Used when you take a photo to attach to a message or to add a contact photo. The camera is not used unless you start that action.
Used when you record a voice note or place a call that requires microphone access. Recording does not run unless you start it.
On Android 12 and below only, storage access may be used so you can attach voice recordings or media files you choose. On newer Android versions the system picker is used where possible.
Incoming calls on lock screen & display over other apps
Rasmi may ask for permission to draw over other apps and to show full-screen incoming call UI so you can answer or decline calls reliably, including when the screen is locked.

Notifications alert you to new messages and calls. Exact alarms and boot completion are used only for scheduled messages and reminders you set; battery-optimization exemption may be requested so those alerts are delivered reliably.

Your messages, call log, contacts, and phone identifiers are processed on your device for dialer and messaging features. Rasmi does not sell this personal data. Network access may be used for MMS, optional link previews, or app updates — not to upload your SMS or call history to our servers.
I have read and agree to these data practices, including core dialer/SMS access and optional camera, microphone, and location when I use those features.
Use the special permissions section below when you are ready. Rasmi does not open those system screens automatically, so you can read each explanation before continuing.
